alate: Head dark reddish brown, labrum, postclypeus and antennae yellowish brown, postmentum brown, pronotum deep yellow, wings deep yellow with a brownish tinge. Pilosity of the pronotum very dense. Head nearly circular, compound eyes elongate-oval and projecting outwards, ocelli flattened-round, the distance to the compound eye less than one-third of their short diameter; postclypeus more than four times as wide as long, with a median suture; fontanelle elongate-oval, divided into two forks at the anterolateral sides. Antennae 15 segments, the second the shortest. Anterior margin of the pronotum rather straight, raised in the middle, the anterior lateral corners drooping downwards, the middle of the posterior margin concave.
soldier: Head and antennae brownish yellow, nasus with a reddish tinge, thorax, abdomen and legs pale greyish yellow; head nearly bare, the tip of the nasus with a few hairs. Large form: head flattened-round, wider than long, the sides roundly projecting; nasus a stout cone, shorter than the head, directed straight forwards in profile with the tip lower than the top of the head, the base of the nasus flat, the angle between nasus and head about 105°; apical spine of the mandibles short and small. Antennae 13 segments, the second the shortest, the third about twice the second, the fourth slightly longer than the second. The anterior part of the pronotum strongly sclerotised, the anterior and posterior margins nearly straight. Small form: colour and pilosity close to the large form, head nearly circular and wider than long, nasus conical, slightly upturned in profile with the tip slightly lower than the top of the head, the base shallowly concave and rising gently towards the top of the head, mandibles with a short apical spine; antennae 12 segments, the second the shortest, the third about 1.5 times the second, the fourth stouter and shorter than the third.
